technique_name: Summarize the article about artificial intelligence.
description: AI is rapidly becoming an integral part of many businesses, leading to increased automation and productivity. AI-driven technologies such as machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and robotics have enabled businesses to gain a competitive advantage in the market. AI is being used in many industries, including healthcare, automotive, and finance, making it one of the major technology trends of the decade.
example: Recently, artificial intelligence (AI) has taken the world, the media, and our businesses by storm, leading to many speculation about the future of AI. AI-driven technologies like machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and robotics have all provided greater automation, accuracy, and productivity, enabling businesses to increase their competitive edge in the market.
